title: Low-frequency audiogram curvature does not establish incremental prediction of diagnosed diabetes across NHANES samples
abstract: In separately sampled NHANES 2001–2002 training and 2003–2004 confirmation adults, bilateral 1-kHz audiogram curvature did not establish improved prediction of reported diagnosed diabetes beyond conventional hearing summaries and risk factors. Target weighted Brier gain was −0.001262 (source/target PSU-refit 95% interval −0.003628 to +0.000513;1702 adults,137 cases). This is a scoped negative result, not proof that audiogram shape lacks metabolic information.
